content: WCAG 2.2 current published recommendation dated 2024-12-12 supplies testable criteria for mobile reflow, target size, non-color state information, authentication assistance, redundant entry, error prevention and status messages. Lafu inference: verify full phone tasks in Indonesian and English with keyboard, zoom, upload failures and banking-app return; meeting accessibility checks does not establish ease of use without user task tests. https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/
